name: envigo
description: Envigo Innovations' Claude Code marketplace. The Subscriby Agentic Kit: the skills, slash commands, subagents and guard rails that teach Claude to run a paid community, integrate the Subscriby REST API and webhooks into any app, and build connectors on the SDK, with the hosted MCP server bundled.

plugins.name: subscriby
plugins.description: Run a paid community, integrate the Subscriby API and webhooks, or build a connector on the SDK, with Claude: skills for creators, developers and connector authors, slash commands, read-only subagents, and the hosted MCP server bundled. Install subscriby-guard beside it for the hook that makes every destructive tool ask first.

plugins.name: subscriby-guard
plugins.description: The companion to subscriby: a PreToolUse hook that makes every Subscriby MCP tool flagged destructive ask before it runs, whatever the session's permission settings. Its matcher is generated from the tool catalogue; it carries the kit's version.
